lines.t: Before empires rose, before doctrines hardened, the Most High spoke and the way was walked.
I stood at the gate where two roads divide. One loud with promise, one quiet with life. The crowd moved fast, their hands held high. But truth stood still and met my eyes.
It didn't offer silver or a throne
It asked for my heart, my will, my bones
Leave what you were, come walk and see
Said the living word calling me
Not written on stone alone
But carved in the heart when the proud let go
Not hearers of words, but walkers made new
A covenant lived, faithful and true
I follow the footsteps in the dust
Where truth stays sharp and pride turns to rust
Not my way, not the voice of men
I walk the path, we walk back then
Through fire refined, through faith aligned
Breath of the most high, filling my lungs
I won't turn back
I won't delay
I walk the way
He touched the outcast
Spoke straight to kings
Called out the lie
Wrapped in hollow things
He honored the Torah
Fulfilled it in light
Every word
Not one denied
No match
No blend
With the world's applause
He stood unmoved
By the threat of loss
Servants hands
Yet authority clear
The kingdom drawn near, right here
Repent means turn, not feel your dread
Change direction, place your steps, viral pact
But the soul runs dry, narrow stays jaw
But the truth stays alive
Commands ain't trees, they're life in motion
Do and think, fueled by devotion
Not religion, not coaching, a man made flame
Set upon living, branded by name
Obedience ain't easy, it cuts through the night
Milo's the way, stand up and fight
Dust on your feet, fire in your heart
Every small step is a brand new start
Turn from the wide, step in the light
Every breath living, walk in his sight
No compromise, no half measures taken
Life's fully given when the king awakens
Strip me clean of borrowed names
Teach my feet your ancient ways
If it cost me all I've been
Let obedience be how I win
I follow the footsteps in the dust
Truth before comfort, obedience first
From dawn to dusk, from breath to grave
I choose the life the Father gave
No turning back, no divided way
The narrow path is where I'll stay
Not tradition
Not the word
Only truth
Lived
In Yahushua
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
